info.title: Orbis Relay API
info.description: Human trust infrastructure for autonomous software. Ask before acting: deterministic policy decides, high-impact actions go to a verified human, every final decision gets an Ed25519-signed receipt.

apiKey.description: Integration key (orb_live_… / orb_test_…). Tenant is derived from the key.

mobile.description: Orbis iOS session token (orbu_…) bound to a registered device.

request_id.description: Idempotency key. Replays with the same payload return the original decision.

signature.description: Ed25519 over canonical JSON of body (base64url)
